name: Desk and mobile phones
summary: Manage university phone service, voicemail and mobile devices

details.title: Desk phone services
details.html: York Telecommunications supports desk phone service, voicemail, call forwarding, conference calling and related features for eligible University units

details.title: Request a desk phone
details.html: The published desk phone guidance requires working with a department telephone designate and supplying a York budget number. Features and service eligibility depend on the departmental telephone arrangement

details.title: Mobile phone services
details.html: Mobile device plans and purchase information are available through a Passport York-protected employee area. No tariff, eligibility or device pricing is reproduced without a verified authorized source
